ei.title: Segmenting vs. Integrating Work and Life
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Boundaries between work and home are blurring as portable digital technology makes it increasingly possible to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to separate or segment roles so that boundary crossings are minimized. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to conduct work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones ― one for work and one for personal use. Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater distinction between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.

questions.passage: Boundaries between work and home are (A)[blurring / sharpening] as portable digital technology makes it increasingly possible to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to separate or segment roles so that boundary crossings are (B)[maximized / minimized]. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to conduct work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones ― one for work and one for personal use. Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater (C)[distinction / confusion] between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) blurring=흐려지는, (B) minimized=최소화되는, (C) distinction=구분
det.analysis:
✅ ① blurring — minimized — distinction: 원문 일치. 일과 가정의 경계가 흐려지고(blurring), 경계를 넘나드는 일이 최소화되며(minimized), 유연한 일정이 더 큰 구분(distinction)을 가능하게 한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② sharpening — minimized — distinction: (A) sharpening(선명해지는)은 blurring(흐려지는)의 반의어
❌ ③ blurring — maximized — distinction: (B) maximized(최대화되는)는 minimized(최소화되는)의 반의어
❌ ④ blurring — minimized — confusion: (C) confusion(혼란)은 distinction(구분)과 다른 의미
det.tip: boundaries blurring / crossings minimized / greater distinction

Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater distinction between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer (C)[integrating / separating] work and family roles all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) differ=다르다, (B) conduct=수행하다, (C) integrating=통합하는
det.analysis:
❌ ① agree — conduct — integrating: (A) agree(일치하다)는 differ(다르다)의 반의어
❌ ② differ — avoid — integrating: (B) avoid(피하다)는 conduct(수행하다)와 다른 의미
❌ ③ differ — conduct — separating: (C) separating(분리하는)은 integrating(통합하는)의 반의어
✅ ④ differ — conduct — integrating: 원문 일치. 개인마다 다르고(differ), 직장에서 일을 수행하며(conduct), 다른 개인은 일과 가정을 통합하기(integrating)를 선호한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: Individuals differ / conduct work at the workplace / prefer integrating roles

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) portable=휴대용의, (B) enable=가능하게 하다, (C) entail=수반하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① portable — prevent — entail: (B) prevent(막다)는 enable(가능하게 하다)의 반의어
❌ ② fixed — enable — entail: (A) fixed(고정된)는 portable(휴대용의)의 반의어
✅ ③ portable — enable — entail: 원문 일치. 휴대용(portable) 기술, 유연한 일정이 더 큰 구분을 가능하게 하며(enable), 통합은 끊임없는 메시지 교환을 수반할(entail) 수 있다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답

det.tip: portable digital technology / schedules enable distinction / might entail trading messages

❌ ① blurring — 일과 가정의 경계가 흐려진다는 맥락 — 적절

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 roles의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: role(s): (A) 영화 속 배역 / (B) 일과 가정에서의 사회적 역할
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 배역 — (B) 역할: (A)는 배우가 연기하는 배역, (B)는 일·가정에서의 사회적 역할을 뜻하므로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 역할 — (B) 배역: (A)의 roles는 영화 맥락에서 배역
❌ ③ (A) 배역 — (B) 명단: (B)의 roles는 명단이 아닌 역할
❌ ④ (A) 임무 — (B) 배역: (A)는 임무가 아닌 배역, (B)는 배역이 아닌 역할
det.tip: role(s): ① (연기의) 배역 ② (사회적) 역할 ③ 명단(roll과 혼동 주의)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a real or imagined line that separates one area or thing from another"

det.korean: boundary=경계 (한 영역을 다른 영역과 나누는 실제 또는 가상의 선)
det.analysis:
❌ ① schedule(일정): 시간 계획으로 정의와 다름
❌ ② responsibility(책임): 해야 할 의무로 정의와 무관
❌ ③ distinction(구분): 차이/구별로 '선'과는 다른 개념
✅ ④ boundary(경계): 한 영역을 다른 영역과 나누는 선으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: boundary = 경계. a line that separates가 핵심 단서

questions.passage: Portable digital technology makes it increasingly __________ (possibility) to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 가목적어 it의 목적격 보어 자리이므로 형용사 possible (명사 possibility → 형용사 possible)
det.analysis: 'makes it increasingly __________ to work'에서 makes의 가목적어 it에 대한 목적격 보어로 형용사가 필요하다. 명사 possibility(가능성)를 형용사 possible(가능한)로 바꾼다. possibility → possible
det.tip: make + it + 형용사 + to V: make it possible to work(일하는 것을 가능하게 하다)

questions.passage: Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater __________ (distinct) between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 형용사 greater의 수식을 받는 명사 자리이므로 distinction (형용사 distinct → 명사 distinction)
det.analysis: 'enable greater __________ between'에서 형용사 greater의 수식을 받고 enable의 목적어가 되는 명사가 필요하다. 형용사 distinct(뚜렷한)를 명사 distinction(구분)으로 바꾼다. distinct → distinction
det.tip: distinct(형용사: 뚜렷한) → distinction(명사: 구분). greater + 명사

questions.passage: Boundaries between work and home are blurring as portable digital technology makes it increasingly possible to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to __________ so that boundary crossings are minimized. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to conduct work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones ― one for work and one for personal use. Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater distinction between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: separate or segment roles=역할을 분리하거나 구획하다 — 분리형(segmenter)은 경계를 넘나드는 일을 최소화하려 역할을 나눈다
det.analysis:
❌ ① combine all their duties into one(모든 일을 하나로 합치다): 역할을 분리하려는 의도와 반대
✅ ② separate or segment roles(역할을 분리하거나 구획하다): 'so that boundary crossings are minimized(경계 넘나듦을 최소화하도록)'와 이어지는 분리형의 특징에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ ignore their family duties entirely(가정의 의무를 완전히 무시하다): 본문에 없는 극단적 내용
❌ ④ work the exact same hours every day(매일 똑같은 시간 일하다): 역할 분리와 무관
det.tip: prefer to separate or segment roles so that boundary crossings are minimized

ch: combine all their duties into one
work the exact same hours every day

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: integrating work and family roles all day long=하루 종일 일과 가정 역할을 통합하는 것 — 통합형(integrator)의 특징
det.analysis:

❌ ② taking frequent breaks from their duties(자주 휴식을 취하는 것): 통합형의 특징과 무관
✅ ③ integrating work and family roles all day long(하루 종일 일과 가정 역할을 통합하는 것): 사무실에서 아이와 문자하거나 집·휴가지에서 이메일을 확인하는 통합형의 특징에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ reducing the total number of hours they work(일하는 시간을 줄이는 것): 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles all day long
